dashboard.subtitle: A quick look at how your store is doing.

products.title: Products

products.emptyDescription: Add your first product so customers have something to buy.

media.hint: Drag to reorder. The first image is the primary image.

options.hint: Add options like colour or size to generate variants automatically.

inventory.title: Inventory

offers.title: Product offers
offers.hint: Offers on this product only. Store-wide discounts live under Campaigns.

related.title: You may also like
related.hint: Pick products to show on this product's storefront page.
related.search: Search for a product to add…

ai.title: Generate product description
ai.description: A draft is suggested from the product data. Edit it before saving.
ai.editBeforeSave: You can edit the text before accepting it.
ai.failed: Generation failed. Check your connection and try again.

products.deleteWarning: The product is archived and hidden from the storefront. Past orders are unaffected.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Follow every order from intake to delivery.
orders.emptyDescription: Orders appear here as soon as your store receives one.
orders.emptyFilteredHint: Try changing or resetting your filters.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search order number, name or phone…

export.title: Export orders
export.description: Only orders matching the current filters are exported.

orders.duplicateWarning: This customer placed {count} orders in the last {hours} hours.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Customer records and buying behaviour.
customers.emptyDescription: A customer record is created automatically with their first order.

callCenter.title: Call center
callCenter.subtitle: Manage agents and order routing rules.
callCenter.emptyAgentsDescription: Add an agent so they can sign in to the call center portal and work their assigned orders.
callCenter.usernameHint: Used to sign in to the portal. Lowercase letters and digits only.
callCenter.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. It is not shown again after saving.
callCenter.deleteAgentWarning: The agent loses access immediately. Orders they handled keep their name in the history.
callCenter.rulesHint: A new order is assigned to the agent of the first matching rule, in order.
callCenter.emptyRulesDescription: Without rules, orders stay unassigned until you assign them manually.

portal.title: My orders
portal.subtitle: Orders assigned to you.
portal.empty: No orders assigned to you right now
portal.emptyHint: Orders appear here as soon as they are assigned.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Delivery methods, carriers and assignment rules.
shipping.emptyMethodsDescription: Add at least one delivery method so customers can check out.

zones.title: Pricing zones
zones.hint: Each zone sets a different price. A zone with no regions acts as the method's fallback price.
zones.name: Zone name
zones.regionsPlaceholder: Type a region and press Enter
zones.citiesPlaceholder: Type a city and press Enter
zones.empty: No zones — the method's base price applies.

shipping.credentialsHidden: Credentials are encrypted and cannot be shown after saving.
shipping.disconnectWarning: Orders will stop being assigned to this carrier automatically.
shipping.rulesHint: Rules are evaluated in order; only the first match applies.
shipping.emptyRulesDescription: Without rules you have to pick a carrier manually for every order.

slip.title: Delivery slip
slip.hint: Choose what appears on the printed slip.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.noDataHint: Change the date range or wait for new orders.

definitionText.deliveryRate: Delivered ÷ orders that reached the shipping stage (shipped + delivered + delivery failed + returned).
definitionText.averageOrderValue: Total sales of non-cancelled orders ÷ their count.
definitionText.conversion: Orders ÷ views. Hidden until enough view events exist.
definitionText.confirmationRate: Confirmed ÷ orders assigned to the agent.

analytics.insufficientEvents: Not enough view events to compute conversion.

checkout.title: Checkout fields
checkout.hint: Decide whether each field is required, optional or hidden at checkout.

checkout.customFieldsHint: Add extra fields to the checkout form.

notifications.enableHint: The browser needs your permission before sounds can play.
notifications.permissionDenied: The browser blocked audio. Allow it in browser settings.

security.fraudHint: Blocks or flags repeated orders from the same phone within a time window.
security.ipHint: Enforced server-side; blocked addresses cannot create orders.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.hint: Used for programmatic access to store data. A token is shown once only.
tokens.revokeWarning: Any application using this token stops working immediately.
tokens.createdWarning: Copy it now — you will not be able to see it again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your own details and password.
profile.emailLocked: Your email cannot be changed here.
profile.localeHint: The language of your dashboard only; it does not affect your store.
profile.changePasswordHint: Changing it signs you out everywhere, including this device.

storefront.emptyCartHint: Browse the products and add what you like.
storefront.codNotice: Cash on delivery — no card needed.
storefront.noProductsHint: This store has not added products yet.

tracking.title: Track your order

tracking.notFound: No order found with those details.

thankYou.title: Order received!

pages.subtitle: Dedicated selling pages for your products.

ai.title: Generate landing page

design.subtitle: Brand identity and theme.

themes.subtitle: Change how your whole storefront looks.

pixels.subtitle: Connect ad tracking tools to your store.

pixels.activeHint: When enabled, the provider’s script loads on storefront pages.
pixels.serverTokenHint: Stored encrypted on the server; it never reaches the browser.
pixels.removeWarning: No further events will be sent to this provider.

staff.title: Staff & permissions
staff.subtitle: Control who can reach what.

audit.title: Activity log
